commit.message:
feat: restructure for composable config architecture

### Added
- components/ directory for atomic pieces (rules, skills, commands, hooks, context)
- profiles/ directory for machine/use-case profiles
- tools/ directory for tool-specific output schemas (claude-code, zed, etc)
- mcp/ directory for MCP server definitions (global vs local)
- schemas/ directory for JSON schema validation
- build/ directory for compilation tooling
- dist/ directory for generated output (gitignored)

### Changed
- Moved all existing content to legacy/ for gradual migration
- Updated README with new architecture and workflow documentation

### Related
- Closes phase 1 of aRustyDev/ai#1
